name: codex
description: OpenAI Codex CLI. Skills live in ~/.codex/skills (SKILL.md convention); headless via 'codex exec'. No subagent tool: phases execute sequentially in one session.

install.headless: cd <target-repo> && codex exec -C . -s workspace-write -m <frontier-model> "Read ~/.codex/skills/vulnhunt/SKILL.md and execute the /vulnhunt workflow on this repository"
install.notes: Use -s workspace-write (results-dir writes) or -s read-only for pure analysis without artifacts; exploit-test runs may need the wider sandbox.
